messages:
Sam W: Kicking off intake for new model 'thor-7b' (community fork). Need weights + tokenizer provenance, registry entry, and basic quant experiments. 48h priority.
Maria L: got it. I can run checksum + artifact scan. where are the uploads?
Sam W: Upload path: s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/weights/model-v1.pt and s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/tokenizer/tokenizer.json
Sam W: KMS alias to use: alias/ingest-signing-prod
Eli R: i'll validate tokenizer vocab and HF format compatibility. will also run a quick tokenization smoke test against our eval set.
Kat P: i'll handle signing after the provenance checks pass. will need digest and uploader principal.
ingest-bot: artifact received: s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/weights/model-v1.pt (uploader: infra-ci)
Maria L: starting checksums + virus/CVE scan now.
Maria L: commands i'm running:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/weights/model-v1.pt /tmp/
sha256sum /tmp/model-v1.pt
s3api head-object --bucket redwood-llm-ingest --key thor-7b/weights/model-v1.pt --query Metadata
```
Maria L: found metadata: {"uploader":"infra-ci","origin":"external-s3","upload_ts":"2025-08-12T17:04:21Z"}
Maria L: sha256 = 7c9f2d9b0f1a3e2d4f6a8b9c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0
Eli R: tokenizer.json looks HF-compatible but has unknown special tokens, running small script to map -> our canonical tokens.
Eli R: quick tokenization smoke (counts OK):
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(t.encode('Hello world').tokens)
```
Eli R: token mappings to confirm: unknown <|special_1|> -> <|extra_unk|> (we'll record mapping in registry)
Nadia S: note on provenance: we need upload signature, uploader principal, original source URL, and model license text blob attached to registry entry.
Sam W: agreed. Maria, can you capture the original manifest and store it under registry metadata key `ingest_manifest`?
Maria L: done. saved manifest JSON to s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/manifest/manifest-1901234567.json
Maria L: manifest includes: source_url, uploader, uploader_id, upload_ts, sha256, file_size_bytes, detected_license
Kat P: ready to sign after QA. request: please provide KMS policy-approved principal and final checksum.
Maria L: KMS principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ingest-signer
Maria L: final checksum confirmed (same as earlier). ready for sign.
Kat P: initiating sign step. signing output stored at s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/signatures/sig-1901234567.asc
Kat P: signature verified by Nadia: OK
Nadia S: adding registry record. minimal registry entry fields:
- model_id: thor-7b
- version: v1
- weights_s3: s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/weights/model-v1.pt
- tokenizer_s3: s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/tokenizer/tokenizer.json
- sha256: 7c9f2d9b0f1a3e2d4f6a8b9c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0
- signature_s3: s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/signatures/sig-1901234567.asc
- license: apache-2.0 (detected)
- provenance: s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/manifest/manifest-1901234567.json
- quant_experiments: [int8-firstpass]

Sam W: good — add tags: priority=P1, onboarding-owner=eng-ml, canary-route=dedicated-gpu-1
Eli R: starting quantization smoke plan: run GPTQ int8 baseline on sample trace (1000 tokens), compare logprob delta vs fp16 across 3 prompts. record throughput & perf.
Eli R: quant command snippet:
```
python3 tools/gptq_quantize.py --model s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/weights/model-v1.pt --bits 8 --out model-v1-int8.pt
```
Eli R: note: set `--per-channel` flag if low accuracy.
Maria L: QA notes: run checksum verification after any transform and store derivative provenance: e.g. model-v1-int8.pt -> sha256: <computed>
Sam W: timeline: tokenizer checks + signing done. quant smoke + eval in 24h. final registry entry with perf metrics after 48h.
Nadia S: I've created registry entry id=reg-2025-THOR-0007 and attached initial metadata.
Sam W: owners confirm: Maria (artifacts), Eli (tokenizer + quant), Kat (signing), Nadia (registry). please update the ticket when done.
Maria L: updating ticket now -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGML-1122
Eli R: starting smoke tests now, will post results in this thread.
Kat P: signing complete and logged.
Maria L: final checksum re-verified after staging copy: match ✅
Eli R: quick eval: int8 throughput +24%, logprob delta ~= -0.6% on 3 sample prompts. saving eval outputs to s3://redwood-llm-ingest/thor-7b/evals/quick-1901234567.json
Sam W: excellent. next: schedule canary on dedicated pool tomorrow morning, A/B with fp16.
Nadia S: leaving a final compliance note: attach license text and a short RAG risk note (external-source: minor, license permissive).
Sam W: thanks team. closing intake loop — any blockers?
Maria L: none from artifact side.
Eli R: none yet, will report if quant regression appears.
Kat P: none.
ingest-bot: thread archived metadata captured.
